_comment: Untuned G1 proposal: dark = L* < max(abs_floor, median_L - rel_drop), no chroma gate. A VAL-only grid search (ml/grading/tune_defect.py, ml/runs/G1/grading_tune/grid.json) found no setting that separates fresh from rotten better (best balanced accuracy 0.638 on val, identical to v0.1), so v0.1 is kept.
